tasks.title: Set up project repository, Node.js/Express backend scaffold, and PostgreSQL database with initial schema for users and authentication
Implement JWT-based user registration and authentication endpoints with university email validation
Create database schema and models for study notes, including metadata fields (title, description, subject, course_code, tags, ratings)
Build React frontend structure with routing, bottom navigation component, and responsive mobile-first layout using design system
Implement AWS S3 integration for file upload/download with backend API endpoints for note storage and retrieval
Design and implement Home Dashboard screen with trending notes list, quick actions, and welcome section per design specifications
Build Search & Browse functionality with real-time search, filter chips, and results display for notes and groups
Create Note Detail View screen with preview, ratings display, download button, and review list components
Implement database schema and API endpoints for study groups (creation, joining, member management)
Build Study Groups screen with My Groups/Discover tabs, group cards, and join functionality
Create User Profile screen with stats, content tabs (My Notes, Saved, Activity), and note management features
Implement Upload Note screen with file picker, metadata inputs, tags, visibility toggle, and group sharing options
Build rating and review system with database schema, API endpoints, and UI components for submitting and displaying reviews
Implement reusable UI component library (buttons, cards, inputs, avatars, badges) matching design specifications
Add search indexing and filtering logic for notes and groups by subject, course, keywords, and university
Implement authentication middleware, route protection, and user session management across all endpoints
Conduct end-to-end testing of core user flows: registration, login, upload, search, download, group join
Deploy MVP to staging environment with AWS S3 configured and PostgreSQL database provisioned

risks: AWS S3 integration complexity may delay file upload/download functionality if not properly configured early
University email validation requirements unclear - may need fallback authentication method for MVP
Database performance issues with search and filtering at scale if indexing not implemented correctly
Mobile responsiveness testing across devices may reveal layout issues requiring design adjustments
User adoption risk if rating/review system not implemented - notes quality may be difficult to assess
